# LeapMultix

> Free, open-source mental math game for children aged 6 to 12: multiplication
> tables, addition, subtraction and division. Available in French, English and
> Spanish. No ads, no account, works offline.

LeapMultix runs in the browser and can be installed as an app. It offers six
game modes and six arcade mini-games, with a recorded voice that reads the
questions. Each player's progress stays on their own device.

## Pages

- [Play LeapMultix](https://leapmultix.jls42.org/): the game
- [Game modes](https://leapmultix.jls42.org/modes.html): what each mode trains
- [Parents and teachers](https://leapmultix.jls42.org/parents.html): guide for adults
- [Install the app](https://leapmultix.jls42.org/pwa.html): offline use
